name: Reluctance to disclose beneficial ownership or control
description: Customer or intermediary is vague, delayed or inconsistent when asked who owns, controls or ultimately benefits from an account, entity or funds.
fp: Complex but legitimate structures and slow third-party registries can cause delay; weigh against documentary support.

links.name: Customer reluctant to disclose beneficial owner or purpose
links.ctx: Customer is vague about who ultimately benefits from the account or the intended use of funds.

links.name: Reluctance to provide beneficial owner information
links.ctx: TCSP resists or delays beneficial ownership details.

links.name: Customer unwilling or unable to explain ownership or control
links.ctx: Evasive, delayed or inconsistent explanations about owners, controllers or purpose.
